# CmisVdmObservableType5p4 — CMIS VDM Observable Type (CMIS 5.4 and later)

<!-- Generated by openxcvr-codegen --lang markdown. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Source schema: `schemas/cmis/enums/vdm-observable-type-5p4.yaml`

- Schema: `openxcvr.enum.v2` (kind `enum`), id `CmisVdmObservableType5p4`
- Description: VDM observable type code set as printed by CMIS 5.4 Table 8-180 (p. 304). CmisVdmObservableType keeps the pre-5.4 window, where type 2 is TEC Current for the module and type 4 is absolute Laser Temperature; CMIS 5.4 corrects type 2 to a media-lane(s) observable (the 5.3 text had described it as module-only) and redefines type 4 as Laser Temperature Deviation (the deviation against the target temperature, S16, 1/256 degC). Revision-blind duplicate-value rules forbid two value-2/value-4 entries in one enum, so the since-5.4 meanings land here, following the CmisBanksSupported5p4 precedent (ADV-01). Every other code point is unchanged from 5.3.
